text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One morning, I'm welcomed by a shrill
and
energetic voice in front of the
academy gate.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: GOOD MORNING!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being greeted in such an explosive
manner at
point-blank range makes me
reflexively take a
number of steps
backward.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm gracing you with a Bakushin
Greeting!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's a student council initiative to instill
the
importance of proper manners into
our students.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The original idea was rather hands-off.
We were
only going to hang posters that
encouraged
students to greet each other
more...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But big Bakushin results are always
better than
slow progress, so I—the class

representative—proposed to take a more
direct
approach!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As such, I'm greeting everyone
immediately upon
their arrival! I've
dubbed this initiative as "The
Bakushin
Greeting"! It's sure to instill the

importance of greetings upon others!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Given that it's a student council
campaign, I'm
here to oversee its
implementation, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well... Stay here and watch a while, and
you'll
see.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, so another observer shall be
taking notes
on my Bakushin Greetings,
eh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Very well! Keep your eyes open and
observe well!
BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I stick around to watch Sakura
Bakushin
O act out her Bakushin
Greeting initiative.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: GOOD MORNING!

text_block_list.name: Shy Student
text_block_list.text: Eek?! Wh-why are you yelling at me?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am simply giving you a Bakushin
Greeting! You
there! GOOD MORNING
TO YOU TOO!

text_block_list.name: Sleepy Student
text_block_list.text:
It's way too early in the morning
for—h-hey, back
up a little!

text_block_list.name: Shy Student
text_block_list.text:
I-if you want us to remember to greet
each
other... I think a gentle reminders
plenty!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, she is quite... passionate
about
her role.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Overboard?! But do you not see how my

passionate greetings are setting
everyone's hearts
ablaze the moment
they step on campus?!
choice_data_list: ちょっとありすぎるような……

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, how do I put this? I'm afraid you
might be
putting people off.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I can tell how motivated you are to do
this, and
part of me wants to let you
carry on as is...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But the purpose here isn't to make the
students
shy away...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see! In other words, my greetings require even more Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems dead set on her approach,
but there
has to be another way she can
express her passion
without stressing out
the students!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suggest that she try waving or striking a
friendly
pose at people instead of
raising her voice at
them.
choice_data_list: 身振り手振りで表現してみるとか
いい標語を考えてみては

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Body language, huh? Yes, a true class

representative should be fluent in this
most
universal of languages! Only then
can I transcend
all barriers!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Good! Morning! Good! Morning!
Goooood!
Morniiing!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's good. Let your movements make
up for
your lowered voice. And do your
best to stay put!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll be back later to see how you're
doing, but if
anything goes awry before
then, come find me
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I was so shocked when Air Groove
said my
method was off-putting!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But Bakushin is here to save the day!
Time to
begin my NEW AND IMPROVED
Universal
Bakushin Greeting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suggest that using a friendly slogan at
a
reasonable volume may be sufficient to
express
the importance of greeting
others.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A catchphrase! Making one is a huge

responsibility indeed! But it's precisely
the kind of
crucial task a class
representative must perform!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Good... Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heh! It's an expression that encapsulates
both the
feeling of a friendly greeting
and the feeling of
Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Good Bakushin! And good Bakushin to
you as
well!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure this will do the trick? She's
just as
raucous as before...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Whatever the case, I'll come back later
to see
how you're doing, but if anything
goes awry
before then, come find me
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All right, my catchphrase is helping the
students
understand my purpose!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I've got to keep it up and share my
Bakushin
energy with all who pass
through these gates!
